text:
alex: heads-up — I'm seeing correlation gaps for requests hitting gpu-proxy in eu-west1 over the last ~2h. Kibana shows many entries without a trace_id and our 5xx alert fired twice.

maria: saw that too. overall log volume from eu-west1 dropped ~30% at 03:12UTC, then partial return around 03:40. Grafana panel for loki_ingest_rate shows a dip. :thinking_face:

jin: quick repro — proxy is passing X-Trace-ID but something upstream chops long headers. here's a hit from the proxy logs: 
```
proxy.request.headers: {"X-Trace-ID":"8a3c1f9e-...-truncated-<cut>"}
service.request.headers: {"X-Trace-ID":"8a3c1f9e-..."}
```
Looks like the header exceeds 64 chars and the envoy filter truncates it.

tara: if trace ids are being truncated mid-UUID we lose joinability in Kibana/Loki. can we check the ingress filter config and the sidecar envoy on the gpu nodes?

alex: query I ran in Kibana (approx): 
```
service:gpu-proxy AND @timestamp >= now-2h AND NOT trace_id:* | sort @timestamp desc
```
Most of the non-joinable hits have a short header value or missing trace_id.

maria: alert details from sleuth: `high-5xx-rate-eu-west1` — fired at 03:18 UTC, resolved 03:42 UTC. SRE-bot posted the alert: see below.

sre-bot: [ALERT] high-5xx-rate-eu-west1 — rate 4.3/s (threshold 3/s). Prom rule: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="eu-west1",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (job)`

jin: config snippet from envoy filter on gpu-proxy (we're running a header size cap): 
```
- name: envoy.filters.http.lua
  typed_config:
    inline_code: |
      local h = request_handle:headers()
      local tid = h:get("X-Trace-ID")
      if tid and #tid > 64 then h:replace("X-Trace-ID", string.sub(tid,1,64)) end
```
That's dumb — we should never mutate trace ids like that. Somebody added it to protect a downstream legacy service.

tara: action: remove the Lua truncation on a canary pod in eu-west1, keep sampling off for 30m, then re-run the Kibana join. Who can do the canary?

alex: I can patch one gpu-proxy canary and restart the sidecar. I'll monitor logs and post the Kibana join after 10m.

maria: cost note — if we turn off sampling and forward full logs from eu-west1 to central for 30m we'll double our ingest egress for that region. estimated ~+$120 for the window. ok for SLO debug?

alex: agreed — authorize for 30m. tagging finance +costs for FYI.

jin: after canary patch, I reproduced full trace propagation. Kibana join now finds matching trace_ids between gpu-proxy and inference-service for the canary pod. snippet of join query: 
```
trace_id:* AND (service:gpu-proxy OR service:inference-service) | stats count() by trace_id
```

tara: nice. next steps: 1) remove truncation globally for eu-west1 (jin + alex), 2) run a 1h sampling-disabled window for correlation tests (maria), 3) add unit test for header handling in envoy bootstrap (eng-runtime). I'll create a follow-up ticket.

maria: also we should update the cost playbook to include a quick calculator for temporary cross-region log windows. saved action: add to runbook. :white_check_mark:

alex: logging the remediation timeline in incident tracker. will paste links in thread once done. thanks all.
